method: Exact provider IDs from provider-roster-matched rows paired once with unique official ESPN roster full/display names; comparison ignores case, accents, spaces, and punctuation, but never adds or removes name tokens. Runtime lookup uses only these exact provider IDs, never a name search. Unmatched or ambiguous names are excluded.
presentationOnly: Portraits do not establish current team membership, availability, identity clearance, or betting status.
